1.product: Silk Unsweet (Organic Unsweetened) Soymilk, 1 cup 240 mL
1.notes: All amounts printed on panel. Folate is mcg DFE. Page copy says 80 kcal and 20% D elsewhere; panel says 90 kcal and 3 mcg (15%). Panel basis shown as 2,000 kcal; formulation may vary by plant/version.

2.product: Almond Breeze Unsweetened Original Almondmilk (refrigerated), 1 cup 240 mL
2.notes: NO B12 on panel or in ingredients (fortified with calcium carbonate, vit A palmitate, D2, E). Fiber printed as <1 g (2% DV), so left null rather than guessed. Fortification varies by Almond Breeze line (shelf-stable differs).

3.notes: This is the sweetened-by-hydrolysis Original (7 g sugar), not an 'unsweetened' product. All amounts printed. B12 only 0.4 mcg (15% DV). Oatly US formulation has changed over time.

4.notes: Potassium printed as 0 mg. Ascorbic acid in ingredients is a preservative, not on panel. Contains almond (blend).

5.product: So Delicious Dairy Free Organic Unsweetened Coconutmilk (carton beverage), 1 cup 240 mL
5.notes: Manufacturer page. A Martin's Foods retailer listing for the shelf-stable non-organic version showed Ca 130, D 3 mcg, A 15% DV, no B12/Mg/Zn amounts (incomplete); not used. Coconut beverage fortification differs across SKUs (refrigerated vs shelf-stable).

6.product: Ripple Original Unsweetened Dairy-Free Pea Milk, 1 cup 240 mL
6.label_basis: new 2016 DV (amounts in mcg; retailer listing, not brand page)
6.notes: DHA algal oil is in ingredients but NO DHA amount on this panel (DHA mg null). Carb printed as <1 g (null) and fiber <1 g (null). Retailer panel lacks an added-sugars line; ripple.com not fetched. Some Ripple labels have listed DHA 25-32 mg on older packs; not verified here.

7.product: Rice Dream Original Enriched Rice Drink, 1 cup 240 mL
7.label_basis: new 2016 DV (has Added Sugars line, D in mcg)
7.notes: B12 is in the ingredients (cyanocobalamin) but no amount on the panel, so null. An older HEB listing (older half-gallon label) showed 140 kcal, 30 g carb, 14 g sugar, D 6.8 mcg, Ca 290, A 160, B12 0.8 mcg (30% DV), K 50; these differ from Kroger, likely older formulation. Retailer pages, brand page not found.

8.product: Tropicana Pure Premium No Pulp Calcium + Vitamin D 100% Orange Juice, 8 fl oz
8.notes: Vitamin C amount not printed; listed 80% DV, converted 0.80 x 90 mg = 72 mg (derived). Vitamin D listed 3 mcg but 10% DV (3/20 would be 15%); flagged inconsistent, 3 mcg used as printed. Fiber not printed (null). Calcium 350 mg = 25% of 1300 consistent.

9.product: Mott's 100% Original Apple Juice (from concentrate, ascorbic acid added), 8 fl oz 240 mL
9.notes: Vitamin C 108 mg printed (120% DV). Another Hannaford listing for the 64 oz bottle shows Vit C 120% DV, iron 1 mg (rounded), sodium 30 mg; consistent. A different HEB listing (/30345) showed odd values (cholesterol 30 mg, Na 29) which were rejected as an obvious error. Fiber not printed.

10.product: Pacific Foods Hemp Unsweetened Original Hemp Milk Beverage, 1 cup 240 mL
10.notes: Full panel found. Total sugars printed as <1 g (null). No B12 or vitamin A. Magnesium and iron are intrinsic (hemp seed), not fortified; Ca (tricalcium phosphate) and D2 are added.
